title: Detect Pattern of Length M Repeated K or More Times
goal: Detect a consecutive pattern of length m repeated at least k times without overlap.
strategy: Comparing entries m positions apart measures continuity between adjacent copies. A run of (k-1)*m equal comparisons certifies the required repeated blocks.
